messages.content: 神舟八号的宇航员是谁

function.name: calculate_tax

income.description: The total income amount in dollars for which the tax is to be calculated. This is a float type value.

filing_status.description: The filing status of the taxpayer.

deductions.description: The total amount of deductions in dollars the taxpayer is claiming. Defaults to 0 if not provided. This is a float type value.

exemptions.description: The number of exemptions the taxpayer is claiming, typically one per dependent. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

message.content: **神舟八号（Shenzhou 8）** 是中国首次对接试验飞行，于 2008 年 9 月 29 日发射。该任务是一次无人试验，目的是验证 Shenzhou 航天员舱与天宫一号（Tianhe）对接系统的功能。由于是无人飞行，**没有宇航员乘坐**。如果你想了解后续载人飞行（如神舟九号、十号等）的宇航员名单，我可以为你提供详细信息。
message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "神舟八号的宇航员是谁" meaning "Who were the astronauts on Shenzhou 8?" They want the names of the crew. We can answer: Shenzhou 8 was a Chinese spaceflight in 2008, with two astronauts: Yang Liwei and Liu Boming? Wait, Shenzhou 8 was a test flight with a robotic probe, I think it had no crew? Actually Shenzhou 8 was an unmanned test flight of the Shenzhou spacecraft, launched on 29 September 2008. It was the first test of the docking system. It had no crew. So answer: It was an unmanned test flight, no astronauts. Provide explanation.
